entries.label: Version 1
entries.prompt:
Redesign the existing Funds Manager personal-finance web app. SAME product behaviour and information architecture — only the visual design and polish change. Output interactive HTML prototypes (multi-file ok) that a developer can implement in React+Tailwind later.

## Product (do not change behaviour)
Self-hosted AU personal finance SPA (no login). Import bank PDF statements, categorise transactions, cash-flow dashboard, net worth, broker serviceability / living expenses / printable reports.

## Navigation IA (keep labels + grouping exactly)
Left sidebar brand "FUNDS":
- Overview: Dashboard, Breakdown, Future predictions
- Cash flow: Transactions, Income, Living expenses, Serviceability, Report snapshots, Repeat payments, Planned spending
- Net worth: Accounts, Assets, Liabilities
- Data & setup: Statements, Categories, Settings

Attention badges can appear on Transactions and Planned spending.

## Screens to design (priority)
1. Dashboard — title "Spending & Income Overview"; account filter + period segmented control (This month / 3 months / 6 months / 1 year / All time); 4 KPI cards (Current Balance, Spending, Income, Net) with vs-prior deltas; monthly Receiving vs Spending bar chart; Spending by Category + Income by Category donuts ("Click a slice to see transactions"); balance-over-time / net-worth charts below.
2. Transactions — dense paginated table; filters: account, search descriptions, All|Uncategorized, Hide transfers; actions Recategorize uncategorized / New category; columns: checkbox, Date, Account, Description, Amount (signed colour), Balance, Status pill, Category picker with colour dot; pagination footer.
3. Statements — PDF upload/dropzone, statement list, missing-period alerts.
4. Categories — parent/sub tree, colour chips, merge/reorder affordances.
5. Serviceability — income, repayments, living costs, surplus (+ stress scenario).

Use realistic AU dollar sample data similar to: balance ~$15k, spending ~$43k / income ~$52k over 6 months, account "People's Choice 9120", merchant-style descriptions.

## Current look to REPLACE
Dark black/slate glassmorphism, purple (#a287cd) active-nav accent, soft glass cards. Functional but generic AI-dashboard / purple-glow vibe.

## New visual direction
Move away from purple glass. Aim for a calm, precise fintech workspace inspired by Linear-quality density and typography:
- Distinctive but restrained; not marketing-landing, not crypto neon, not purple gradients, not cream+terracotta editorial, not newspaper broadsheet.
- Light OR dark is fine — pick ONE coherent system. Prefer a confident dark charcoal OR warm off-white paper workspace — not both themes in one deliverable.
- Expressive loaded fonts (not Inter/Roboto/system). Clear type hierarchy; tabular numbers for money.
- Sidebar remains primary nav; keep one composition per page; avoid card-for-card's-sake — use surface only when it aids scanning of KPIs/charts/tables.
- Charts: clear, legible, restrained motion (subtle hover only).
- Preserve all interactive affordances (filters, category pickers, upload, badges) as working UI chrome in the prototype (can be static data).

## Deliverables
- Shared tokens (CSS variables) + layout chrome (sidebar + page shell)
- Separate HTML pages or routed views for the 5 priority screens above
- A short README/notes block in the entry file listing what stayed the same behaviour-wise vs what changed visually
- Desktop-first (~1280–1440), usable at ~1024

Do not invent new features or rename nav items. Do not add auth screens.
